definition: A description map semiconjugates every primitive transition in an explicitly specified intervention family to a macro transition. The exact existence criterion is preservation of equality of selected coarse data. This entails agreement over all finite histories in that family, not unrestricted causal or explanatory reduction.
note: Analyst interpretation of Mathlib Function.Semiconj, using Function.FactorsThrough for the exact closure criterion. The family of admissible interventions is explicit and can invalidate the reduction when enlarged.
